systems.owner: Government through its electoral-process support structure, in collaboration with and supervised by the CNE

systems.system: Conservatórias e Delegações do Registo Civil
systems.country_label: Conservatórias e Delegações do Registo Civil
systems.tiers: send the electoral support structure, by 31 December each year, a list of citizens over 18 who died in the year (art. 28); the law does not say how the register is kept

note: Lei n.º 11/2013 is the electoral registration law: an electoral register is outside the sub-indicator's class, and the law says nothing of how civil registry offices record births or deaths. The capture is truncated at art. 51.
